About Manchester United

Discover the history, legends, stadium and values behind one of football's most famous clubs.

OUR STORY

A Club Built on History

Manchester United is one of the world's most recognised football clubs. The club was founded in 1878 as Newton Heath before becoming Manchester United in 1902.

Over the years, the club has created a rich history filled with memorable players, managers, trophies and unforgettable moments.

The Red Devils

Manchester United are famously known as the Red Devils, while their home stadium, Old Trafford, is often called the Theatre of Dreams.

THE THEATRE OF DREAMS

Old Trafford is the home of Manchester United and is located in Manchester, England.
